statements.statement: The town lost its 40R smart growth reimbursement mid-year, and the town manager does not plan to budget it next year.
Chapter 70 rose by about this amount last year, moving the town from minimum aid to foundation aid.
Conservative local receipts estimates should cover the lost aid at year-end close.
Active employee health insurance will rise no more than this rate, with the final number due mid-February.

warnings.condition: given the late date and lack of a preliminary budget
warnings.prediction: An override this year is unrealistic and would likely fail, so a stronger attempt should wait for fiscal 26.
Staff are squeezed and the budget will be tight without structural change to Prop 2.5.
